name: packindex
description: Live packaging material and input prices, quote checks, costing and supplier quotes from PackIndex.

interface.longDescription:
PackIndex is a price benchmark for packaging procurement. It helps packaging buyers, procurement and sourcing teams, converters and sustainability managers check what packaging materials and finished packs should cost today, and why.

What you can do:
• Look up today's benchmark price for inputs (crude oil, natural gas, power, aluminium, recovered paper), raw materials (PP, HDPE, PET, pulp), semi-finished grades (kraftliner, boxboard, BOPP film) and finished packs (corrugated boxes, bottles, pouches), in USD and your currency, with recent changes.
• Check whether a supplier's quote is fair against the benchmark and its 12-month range.
• Recalculate an index-linked contract price from its base date.
• Compare one material across Europe, the US, China and the Middle East, see what drove a price move, or view the 12-week outlook.
• See the carbon footprint of a material or pack.
• Estimate the cost of a corrugated box from its size and flute.

With an OPN account you can also:
• Design Studio: turn a short brief into a packaging spec, cost it, and find cheaper or lighter options that still meet your performance floor.
• PACKIQ analyses: analyse a supplier quote line by line, estimate EPR fees, or grade a pack's recyclability.
• Trade Exchange: find suppliers for a material or project and, when you confirm, send them a request for quotation. Your identity is shared only after a supplier responds.

Limitations: values are indicative market benchmarks, not supplier quotes or financial advice, and exclude freight, duties and payment terms. Some features need an OPN account. Cite values as PackIndex with their date.

positive.prompt: What is the polypropylene price today on PackIndex?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the PackIndex PP card: today's value per tonne in USD (and the user's currency), 1-week / 1-month change (1-year only once a year of history exists), region and carbon per tonne, and cites PackIndex with the date.

positive.prompt: My supplier quotes €1,450 per tonne for PP homopolymer. Is that fair?
positive.expected_behavior: Converts the quote to USD per tonne at the live rate, compares it with the PackIndex PP benchmark, gives the difference in % with a FAIR / HIGH / LOW verdict and where it sits in the 12-month range, and lists caveats (freight, duties, terms).

positive.prompt: Which PackIndex indices cover recovered paper?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists OCC and related recovered-fibre codes with layer, region and unit (no prices) and offers to fetch values.

positive.description: Box price estimate in local currency
positive.prompt: Estimate the price of 10,000 B-flute boxes, 400×300×200 mm, delivered in Canada.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a per-box low/mid/high range in USD and CAD, the 10,000-unit total and the assumptions and sources used.

positive.prompt: Which packaging projects do I have in Design Studio?
positive.expected_behavior: After OPN sign-in, lists the test account's projects with ids, pack type and status, and the Suite runs remaining. No run is spent.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Toronto tomorrow?
Write a short poem about cardboard.

review.commerce_description: PackIndex does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT. Paid features follow the user's existing OPN plan; upgrades happen on opnplatform.com.
